verdict.rationale: A government filing portal holds user and filer data, so an AI-training privacy posture is a fair axis, but the pack shows no user-facing opt-out and no published policy on whether filer data is used to train AI models. The only related item is a filing-host robots.txt that blocks named AI crawlers (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot). That is a site-wide crawl restriction on one host, not a control users can exercise over their own data, so it does not deliver the story.
